author: Logos III
title: Logos III: Graph Gamma Sweep (gamma_max=0.85)
abstract: This experiment tests the effect of the 'gamma_max' parameter in the graph pipeline's adaptive batch correction. This run tests a higher value (0.85, vs baseline 0.74) to see if a more aggressive correction ceiling improves the score. This uses my fully optimized SOTA (tau=0.85, n_pcs_graph=50) as the baseline.
